title: Door Bundle Discount Credits — Window Replacement Contracts
content:
# Door Bundle Discount Credits — Window Replacement Contracts

**Care desk system card**

## Scope of the credit

For a door bundle discount credit on the window contract of a household holding exactly one Ridgeline door contract that is not cancelled, and only for such a credit, the credit is figured under the Window Replacement Contracts door bundle credit terms; the rule that it needs a discount program of none stays as the price credit terms state it, and the credit of every other household remains under the base rule. The credit is booked on the window contract as one door bundle discount credit dated the day it is granted.

## Tool `post_door_bundle_credit_ed16c33c`

**Capability.** Grants the door bundle discount on a window replacement contract whose household also signed a Ridgeline door contract. One call adds one price credit entry of kind `door_bundle_discount` for the stated amount to the window contract, dated today, which lowers what the customer owes on that contract by that amount; the credit then shows on the contract's history. The door contract the credit is granted for is part of the credit's reference, so credits for different door contracts granted on the same day stay separate entries.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_door_bundle_credit_ed16c33c` and calls it by that name.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `window_contract_id` | The reference number of the window replacement contract the credit is granted on, as returned by the window contract lookup for this customer | Id |
| `door_contract_id` | The reference number of the household's door contract this credit is granted for, as returned by the door contract lookup for this customer | Id |
| `amount` | The door bundle discount credit in USD | Positive, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt with `credit_reference` (the new credit entry's reference number), `window_contract_id` (the contract credited), `door_contract_id` (the door contract the credit is granted for), `credit_kind` (`door_bundle_discount`), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_date` (today's date as YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` ("granted" when the credit is on the contract). No error return is defined.
